name: Yalangtoʻsh Bakhodir
role: Uzbek military commander, emir of Samarkand
contribution: He belonged to the Olchin tribe of Uzbeks and served as the governor of Samarkand since 1626

checks.lead: Yalangtoʻsh Bahodir (Persian: یلنگ‌تاش بهادر) 1578, Bukhara, Bukhara Khanate - 1656, Samarkand, Bukhara Khanate), a major representative of the military-owning nobility during the Janid era. He belonged to the Olchin tribe of Uzbeks and served as the governor of Samarkand since 1626. Yalangtosh Bahadir was brought up under Bukhara Khan Abdulla Khan
